label: DESIGN_ASSUMPTIONS_NOT_MEASURED
seed_note: Deterministic arithmetic and archived public data; no random sampling.
baseline_scope: Whole always-on dry-state budget including sleeping MCU, rain front-end, regulators and leakage; not a datasheet measurement.
active_cycle_note: Existing T05 illustrative incremental cycle: 0.002 W * 140 s + 0.2 W * 20 s + 0.1 J. Extra to passive tasks. Not changing its runtime configuration.
limitations: No garment-time prediction; no real electrical measurements; budgets omit dedicated wind instrumentation and an always-on gateway. Rainier activity may exceed the baseline. PV derating and exposure are separate assumptions, not actual glass or balcony measurements. Battery sizing is average energy only; no peak, temperature, aging, recharge or lifetime guarantee. Prices not quoted.
